title: Mobility Equipment Warranty Terms — New-Chair Diagnostic Allowance on Battery Sets
content:
# New-Chair Diagnostic Allowance — Battery Sets on Mobility Equipment

**Term.** A new-chair diagnostic allowance is added to the labor units Summit Ridge claims from the manufacturer for a warranty battery-set replacement on a Mobility Equipment chair, by the days from the chair's delivery date to the day the claim is posted: 2 units for no more than 14 days, 1 unit for more than 14 but no more than 60 days, and nothing for a longer span.

## Schedule

| Days from the delivery date to the posting day | New-chair diagnostic allowance |
|---|---|
| 0 to 14 | 2 units |
| 15 to 60 | 1 unit |
| 61 or more | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, chair delivered 1 March)

| Claim posted | Days since delivery | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 15 March | 14 | 2 units |
| 16 March | 15 | 1 unit |
| 30 April | 60 | 1 unit |
| 1 May | 61 | none |

## Points of the term

- **Which date starts the count?** The delivery date on the chair's wheelchair record.
- **Which date ends it?** The day the battery-set claim is posted.
